name: nanoskills
description: nano skills: turn a video idea (nanocrt), a folder of existing footage (nanostory), or a product idea (nanoprd) into a structured, editor- or agent-ready deliverable through five gated phases. Portable across Claude Code and OpenCode.

plugins.name: nanoskills
plugins.description: nano skills bundle: nanocrt (idea-first video idea to two-column A/V script), nanostory (footage-first existing travel footage to narrated script + edit plan), nanoprd (product idea to nanotasks for a coding agent). All three run five gated phases with approval gates.
